_about: Your scanner settings. Every screener uses the 'standard' filters plus its own. Percent values are percents (10 = 10%).

launch._about: Who can be on the Launches list and trigger alerts (not the other screens). Change a number here; it applies from the next evening scan.

earnings._about: Who shows on the Earnings tab (radar/earnings.py), checked on the last close before the stock first comes on the week's list. Your rules, Nov 3 2026. No market cap ceiling here (the user, Nov 16 2026: NVDA was missing; the $2T ceiling stays on the scans only).

standard._min_pct_above_52w_low: price at least 30% above the 52-week low (your 'true 30%'; in TradingView: 'Price above Low 52W by 30% or more')

EP-GAPUP-BREAKOUT._close_chg_pct: the gap day must also CLOSE up this much or more vs the day before (the user, Nov 14 2026: 'it has to close above 5% for the day'); 0 = off

DAILY TIGHTNESS._min_tight_days: today is a tight day and at least 3 of the last 5 days (today included) were tight (low volume + narrow range); set within_last_days to 3 for 3 in a row
DAILY TIGHTNESS._range_vs_avg10_max: today's high-low range at most 0.8 x the average range of the previous 10 days (same as MSF 'Tight day: range <= X x 10-day avg range'); 0 = off

screeners._rel_vol_days: relative volume = the day's volume vs the average of this many sessions before it; 20, the same as Launches, Start days and TradingView (the user, Nov 17 2026: 'for rvol it should 20'; was 10)

lists._new_mover_days_without_setup: 1-UPDAY: off after this many trading days without reaching 3-SETUPS; 0 = off (the user, Nov 21 2026: 'take 15 day rule of for upday as well'; was 15; off 1-EP/GAP since Nov 14)
lists._delete_below_pre_gap_close: 1-EP/GAP: off the list on a close below the close of the day before the gap = the whole gap given back (the user, Nov 14 2026, VIR Nov 12 2026: 12.12 under 12.21); a dip under the gap day's low that holds inside the gap stays
lists._setups_higher_high_low: off (your choice, Oct 25) · strict = the last two swing highs and lows are rising · structure = stays on until price breaks the last higher low
lists._no_chase_1y_pct: off (your choice, Oct 25); a number (e.g. 300) skips stocks up that much in 12 months

ep_pullback._about: EP pullbacks (the user, Nov 23 2026): the first touch of the rising 10 / 21 EMA after an EP day (the 1-EP/GAP rule), bought on the 15-minute reclaim (radar/epp.py has the rule and the study's numbers). The evening scan writes setups/ep_pullback.json (scanner/launch.py write_ep_pullback), the live job alerts READY and BUY (radar/alerts.py find_epp), the Watchlist tab lists them (EP PULLBACKS). A change here applies from the next evening scan
ep_pullback._e10_max_sessions: the 10 EMA touch has to come within this many sessions after the EP day
ep_pullback._e10_floor_pct: the 10 EMA play: no daily close more than this % under the EP day's close since the EP, and no buy more than this % under it
ep_pullback._e21_max_sessions: the 21 EMA touch has to come within this many sessions after the EP day (and never a trade under the EP day's low before it). 15 since Nov 24 2026 (the user's go; was 30): Jan 2023 - Nov 2026 the touches of sessions 16-30 made 121 trades, 17% won, -2R, and sessions 16-20 lost on every single day (50 trades, -31R)
ep_pullback._e21_min_range_pos: the 21 EMA play: no trade while the 21 EMA sits in the bottom this share of the EP day's range, measured from its low (0) to its close (1): by then the stock has given the EP day back (the user, Nov 24 2026, YOU Nov 23 2026: EP close 59.08, low 51.27, the 21 EMA 52.39 = 0.14: 'since the episodic pivot day this was just breaking down'). Jan 2023 - Nov 2026: 225 such touches, 30 trades, +2R; 0.1 / 0.2 / 0.25 gave nearly the same; 0 = off
ep_pullback._max_gap_pct: EP days with a bigger gap are left out (as in the study)
ep_pullback._near_pct: the Watchlist's EP PULLBACKS 'now' view shows a name as NEAR when its price is within this % over its EMA level

msf._about: MSF settings that differ from the Pine script's defaults (v29.4; coil = 3 candles in both)
